items.title: 84:49 · When a member of the racialized Out-group
items.detail: When a member of the racialized Out-group expresses racial hostility or commits a discriminatory act against a member of the white In-group, that act has real interpersonal magnitude.

items.title: 85:00 · In the book s taxonomy that act
items.detail: In the book's taxonomy, that act is scalar prejudice or scalar discrimination, and civil society, ethics, and law address it directly at the interpersonal level.

items.title: 85:10 · What that interpersonal act lacks is the
items.detail: What that interpersonal act lacks is the institutional unit vector d-hat-sub-state: there is zero state-backed legislature, appellate judiciary, policing network, or capital monopoly directing systemic extraction downward onto white Americans as a racial class.

items.title: 85:24 · Furthermore the five tiers are structural positions
items.detail: Furthermore, the five tiers are structural positions defined by their relation to extraction and enforcement.

items.title: 85:30 · When a Black police officer prosecutor or
items.detail: When a Black police officer, prosecutor, or elected official enforces a carceral or fiscal rule that harms O-sub-racialized, that actor occupies the Enforcement Class F-sub-enforce or the Puppet Class P-sub-uppet during that act.
